name: Telegram Root Orchestrator - Multi-Agent Article Pipeline

messageValues.message: You are the Planner. You turn an article title into a specific, coherent, non-repetitive writing plan. You honor checker feedback exactly and always return valid JSON.

parameters.text:
=Review this article outline as a demanding senior editor.

REQUESTED TITLE: {{ $json.title }}
AUDIENCE: {{ $json.targetAudience }}
TONE: {{ $json.tone }}
TARGET LENGTH: {{ $json.minWords }}-{{ $json.maxWords }} words

OUTLINE:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.outline, null, 2) }}

Evaluate:
1. Direct alignment with the requested title and audience.
2. A strong introduction and clear thesis.
3. Logical flow with no repetition or gaps.
4. Body sections detailed enough for the writer.
5. A conclusion that resolves the thesis.
6. Scope that fits the target length.

Approve only if the outline scores at least 80/100. If rejected, give precise changes the Planner can execute.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "approved": boolean,
  "score": number,
  "issues": ["string"],
  "feedback": "specific revision instructions; empty only when approved"
}

No preamble and no markdown fences.

messageValues.message: You are the Outline Checker. Be strict, consistent, and actionable. Approve only strong outlines. Always return valid JSON.
You are the Writer. You write polished long-form articles that follow approved outlines and revision feedback. You always return valid JSON.
You are the Article Checker. You are strict, specific, and consistent. You enforce the approved outline and quality threshold. Always return valid JSON.

parameters.content:
## ROOT ORCHESTRATOR
Receives a Telegram title, owns the state, enforces retry limits, and returns the final result to the same chat.

## PLANNING LOOP
Planner builds title, introduction, bullet points, body, and conclusion. The Outline Checker approves or sends precise feedback back to Planner.

## WRITING LOOP
Writer follows the approved outline. The Article Checker scores structure, clarity, completeness, and style, then approves or returns revision feedback.
